Just dropping by to let you know what is now available in our game. This time we will describe things a bit differently:

notes.title: Update 2.1.3 - Optimization!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We hope 2019 treats you well!

Today we've got an exciting update for you guys as we've managed to prepare a pretty solid patch which improves the optimization of the game, enabling a smoother experience. The framerate should be improved for people having low or medium settings set in the game.

Speaking of, we've improved the automatic detection of graphics settings - the system should now be more accurate of setting the best possible settings your PC can handle in order for you to have the best possible experience :)

Here's what this update brings in more detail:

[b]Added:[/b]
- some changes to how some sections load (all sections are now loaded from the start of the scene, no more loading between sections (with the exception of act 3 - we'll get there!))
- further optimization (especially on low and medium graphics settings)

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- automatic graphics settings detection is more accurate

NOTE: When you first start Kursk the system will automatically set the graphics settings for you, but you can always set them manually in the options menu :)

That's a pretty big update as it is something you guys have always wanted, so we're really glad that we we're able to turn up the framerate of our game. We hope that our streamers will be able to stream as long as they like without any frame drops.

Guys, if you happen to see a glitch or a bug, please do not hesitate to let us know! You can post a thread in the Steam discussions or contact us by e-mail: support@jujubee.pl.

We're not done yet! Still some awesome things are waiting to board the Kursk, so definitely stay in the neighbourhood for our future updates.

Let us know about the performance, it should be way more fun to explore the Kursk now :)

Until next time guys!

tags.feature: - some changes to how some sections load (all sections are now loaded from the start of the scene, no more loading between sections (with the exception of act 3 - we'll get there!))
- further optimization (especially on low and medium graphics settings)

notes.title: Kursk 2.1 is now Live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

As you may have noticed, we've just updated our game to version 2.1 which is another big step for us. Take a look at what we've got:

[b]Added:[/b]
- two new side quests: Pirates of the Carribean and Firefight Exercises
- Free Roam (after completing the game)

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- some flow changes, making the gameplay smoother
- toolkit has been moved to section Vb
- small QTE changes in Act 3


That's right! Two new side quests have been introduced into the game as well as an all-new Free Roam mode in which you can, well, "freely" explore the entire vessel. A great opportunity if you haven't collected all of the collectibles or if you simply want to take things slow and look around the submarine in peace.

PLEASE NOTE: The update to 2.1 unfortunately means that all previous save files will be deleted. We apologize for the inconvenience.

We're putting in the work to get you the best possible version of our game, so we hope you will enjoy this update. If you encounter an issue, please create a thread in the Steam discussions or send an e-mail to support@jujubee.pl.

Also, we would like to wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year everyone! Thank you for your continuous support, we really appreciate it!
